sources.entry: MacVirtue - Run free and unlimited Virtual Machines on your Mac.

summary.name: MacVirtue
summary.one_liner: MacVirtue is a Mac app for running unlimited, isolated macOS virtual machines on Apple silicon, listed by Nadenco as part of its seven-app Mac utility line-up.
use_cases: Running multiple macOS versions on one Mac
Testing software in an isolated macOS environment
Trying out macOS without affecting the host Mac
Setting up a secondary virtual macOS for development
Creating virtual machines without prior experience
summary.what_it_does: MacVirtue creates macOS virtual machines on Apple silicon Macs, with the page stating the VMs are unlimited and free. Each VM is described as securely isolated from the host Mac. The page says it runs Apple silicon VMs without a translation layer, which it claims makes them fast. It offers a guided OS installation process that the page says needs no prior experience. The page lists the last published version as 1.0.1 and compatibility with macOS 12 and later.
notable: Unlimited, free macOS virtual machines on Apple silicon
Each VM isolated from the host Mac
caveats: Requires Apple silicon and macOS 12 or later
Page is largely marketing; no technical specs, limits or documentation are given beyond the listed claims
